<!-- DO NOT EDIT | GENERATED CONTENT -->

Copy models from an external drive, or any folder, into the Hugging Face cache the
server reads, so 'llm-helper new <org/model>' loads them with no download.

The drive can hold a Hugging Face cache (also one made by 'llm-helper export'), an
'hf download --local-dir' folder, or a model folder. The last two do not record
which repo they are, so name it with --repo (and --revision unless the folder is
a git clone).

Every file is checked against its recorded hash as it is copied, an interrupted
import resumes where it stopped, and nothing already in the cache is overwritten.
With --recipe the models go where that recipe's engine reads them.

## Usage

```console
llm-helper import <drive-path> [org/model...] [flags]
```

## Options

### --all

|      |        |
| ---- | ------ |
| Type | `bool` |

import every complete model on the drive

### --cache

|      |          |
| ---- | -------- |
| Type | `string` |

hub cache directory to import into (default: the one the server reads)

### --dry-run

|      |        |
| ---- | ------ |
| Type | `bool` |

show what would be copied and stop

### --recipe

|      |          |
| ---- | -------- |
| Type | `string` |

import the models a tested recipe pins, into the cache its engine reads

### --repo

|      |          |
| ---- | -------- |
| Type | `string` |

org/model of a folder that is not a Hugging Face cache

### --revision

|      |          |
| ---- | -------- |
| Type | `string` |

commit of a folder that is not a Hugging Face cache or git clone
